session_1.speaker: Ava
session_1.text: Hey Ben! Good to see you! How have you been?

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Hey Ava! Good to see you! Work has been crazy. Anything new?

session_1.speaker: Ava
session_1.text: I went to a pottery class yesterday and made my first bowl.
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a blue ceramic bowl

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: That's awesome! I started training for a half marathon in Utrecht.

session_1.speaker: Ava
session_1.text: Good luck with the training, Ben!

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Hey Ava! Long time no talk! How's it going?

session_2.speaker: Ava
session_2.text: Hey Ben! Great to hear from you. I adopted a cat named Mochi last week.

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Mochi is a cute name! My half marathon is next Sunday.

session_3.speaker: Ava
session_3.text: Hey Ben! How was the race?

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Hey Ava! I finished the half marathon in Utrecht in 1 hour 52 minutes.

session_3.speaker: Ava
session_3.text: Amazing! Mochi knocked my pottery bowl off the shelf this morning and broke it.

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Oh no! Will you make another one at the class?
